entries.2f563ae2909bd873: The company group's largest reportable segment by revenue, producing vinyl chloride resin, caustic soda, modifiers, biodegradable biopolymers, modified silicone polymers and others. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥327,235 million (down 4.6% year on year). Revenue declined as weak market conditions in Asia and subdued demand in the U.S. housing and construction market continued.

entries.4883cbd20b7f254f: This is a reportable segment engaged in medical devices, low-molecular-weight pharmaceutical raw materials, APIs and biopharmaceuticals. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥82,975 million (up 7.4% year on year). Sales of blood purifiers and catheters grew, and revenue increased. In this period, the company received the transfer of the medical equipment business in the digestive and cardiovascular fields.
entries.8d619cf9ce3e499e: This category covers non-life and life insurance agency services and on-site work at the company, among others, and is not a reportable segment. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,109 million (up 5.4% year on year); because it is not a reportable segment, it is placed at the end of the list. The main affiliates are Kaneka Takasago Service Center Co., Ltd. and Kaneka Insurance Center Co., Ltd.
entries.911d409399018025: A comprehensive chemical manufacturer that produces a wide range of products, including PVC resin, foamed resin, medical devices and functional food ingredients, and sells them around the world.
entries.c574dcba7282dbdc: A reportable segment that produces foamed resins, extruded foam boards, polyimide film, solar cells, residential storage batteries, acrylic synthetic fibers and others, providing them for housing and the information society. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥194,340 million (up 1.8% year on year). Revenue increased as the foamed resin business and the solar cell and storage battery business were steady.
entries.e76d1ce568b5cc51: A reportable segment handling functional food ingredients, lactic acid bacteria, margarine, shortening, baker's yeast, spices, and functional fertilizers and feed. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥205,977 million (up 5.6% year on year). Revenue increased as coenzyme Q10 (reduced form) spread overseas, mainly in the United States, and lactic acid bacteria sales also grew.
